description: This file is a TypeScript source file for the Playwright project, implementing CLI driver functions such as runDriver, runServer, and launchBrowserServer, including setup for communication and server management.

methods.name: printApiJson
methods.description: Outputs the contents of the api.json file as a JSON string.

methods.name: runDriver
methods.description: Initializes dispatcher connection, sets up message handling, and manages process signals for the driver.

methods.name: runServer
methods.description: Starts a Playwright server with specified options and logs the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: launchBrowserServer
methods.description: Launches a browser server for a specified browser name, optionally using a configuration file.
